title: Static evidence collection dominates the current recording overhead
expected_semantics: Selecting a bounded debug capture policy should add a measured, controlled cost and should not require repeated full compiler projections for every event.
actual_behavior_limitation: The bootstrap adapter launches execute plus trace, IR, SSA, source-study when applicable, and a separate native-core execute. The measured cost is process/static-projection overhead, not an optimized in-runtime trace path.
why_capability_matters: Heavy tracing can perturb timing and resource behavior, making the evidence less trustworthy and making failure-only operation impractical for larger programs.
current_workaround: Bound output/events, run static collection once per witness, preserve capture policy, and publish median direct-versus-recording observations without pretending they are runtime instrumentation benchmarks.

host_language_code_required.why: Current MNCS has no in-process artifact library or event sink, so process boundaries are required to collect existing structured documents.
host_language_code_required.changes_semantics: may_change_timing; does not change recorded semantic fields

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Provide a native bounded debug event sink and reusable compiler metadata API, with disabled/failure-only/selected/full diagnostic modes and explicit overhead counters.
alternatives_considered: remove static evidence to look faster
resolution_criteria: A native benchmark reports bounded capture overhead separately from compiler/static collection, and selected capture modes avoid redundant process launches while preserving required event semantics.

campaign_review.disposition: Failure-only capture is bounded and integrated, but the measured bootstrap/static overhead remains high and was not hidden.
campaign_review.workaround: Keep normal PASS capture disabled; bound events and retain digest references.
